# shmuelie-copilot

Copilot CLI sessions, reports, usage analysis, playbooks, session management, and
plugin authoring.

**Version:** 0.2.1

```text
copilot plugin marketplace add shmuelie/shmuelie-skills
copilot plugin install shmuelie-copilot@shmuelie-skills
```

See the [plugin & skill reference](../../../docs/plugins.md#shmuelie-copilot),
the [marketplace overview](../../../README.md), and the
[changelog](../../../CHANGELOG.md) for details.
